items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And we had ... the Mills Brothers ... Then after that that that broke up -- and John Mills got sick, you see, the Mills Brothers. That's when he died was that year.

ctx.x: That was a fantastic show. We played all the theaters all over the East Coast. We didn't go west.
Then after that that that broke up -- and John Mills got sick, you see, the Mills Brothers. That's when he died was that year. He got tuberculosis.
